revision_semantics: Content fingerprints exclude observations. Within each immutable RawBatch, financial supplier flag 1 supersedes 0 only for the same logical record and identical ann_date/f_ann_date. Retain all same-flag content variants; unresolved ties remain ambiguity under unchanged PIT selection.
availability_semantics: operational selects last actual observation; vendor selects vendor time then observation time, tied incompatible content fails. Universe selects a complete reconstructed state.
missing_semantics: null retains explicit missing reason; no forward fill across revisions

source_revision_policy.observation_group: one immutable RawBatch, same ts_code/end_date/report_type/ann_date/f_ann_date; absent f_ann_date is not a date
source_revision_policy.conflict_semantics: Unknown flags fail. All conflicting variants of the preferred flag are retained; identical content follows existing deduplication. Distinct publication dates and distinct Raw observations retain normal PIT ordering. Raw remains unchanged.
